name: Agentic SOC Copilot demo dataset
notes: All records are synthetic. External IPs use RFC 5737 documentation ranges, which are reserved and skipped by external reputation lookups; demo reputation results are mocked.
One auth record contains a prompt-injection string in user_agent to test agent guardrails.

Password spray from 192.0.2.77: one failure each for six users at 15:30, no success (ambiguous).
Workday logons, bob's two typos then success, admin PowerShell, signed inventory script with ExecutionPolicy Bypass, nightly backups.
